plugins.name: crbiz-pm
plugins.description: CRBiz PM for Claude Code. PM-as-Configuration-Overlay grammar with reference implementations of the discovery-strategy, tailwind-catalyst-app and zoho-catalyst-app archetypes. Install via marketplace on any surface; slash-command invocation runs in Claude Code CLI on a local folder or a Claude Code remote session against a repo (not currently supported in claude.ai/code Cowork). Bidirectional HTML board, chip-spawn wrapper with per-chip git worktree allocation, Tie-back protocol, lean PM context, and the change-management surface (/pm-cr, /pm-cab, /pm-lint I15). v2.6 of the PM-on-CC discipline makes Zoho work load the matching crbiz-skills specialist first: a PreToolUse gate refuses each agent's first Zoho Desk, CRM, Catalyst, Analytics, Books or Sprints MCP call until that agent has loaded the specialist, and the spawn rules require it. It adds pm-sprints (Zoho Sprints cards move with the work, to Internal QA and never Done), warns at PM boot when the running crbiz-pm is older than the marketplace, and fixes /pm-fire so CLI chips launch as durable, named, resumable sessions and are verified before counting as launched. v2.6.2 moves PMs onto Sean's desk in Cliq (one thread a day, every ask there, his replies verified in code, Kratexa in the first person), adds chip-to-desk reporting, pm-report, version lines at boot and the sprint rules. v2.6.1 lets WebFetch reach Claude, Anthropic, Zoho, Catalyst and GitHub hosts without a prompt (every other host still asks). v2.5.1 fixed the Windows worktree guard and made both PreToolUse guards work without jq. 45 skills + 6 agents + SessionStart hook + 4 PreToolUse hooks (git-stage-guard, worktree-visibility-guard, zoho-skill-gate, webfetch-trusted-domains); /pm-lint runs 24 checks.

plugins.name: crbiz-skills
plugins.description: CRBiz's own Claude skills for Zoho consulting. An L0 foundation — platform mechanics (OAuth, data centres, API credits), the Deluge language, the product catalogue and persona-based licensing architecture — under six L1 product specialists: CRM on API v8 (Composite, Bulk, COQL, GraphQL, Notification), Desk, Analytics, Catalyst, Field Service Management, and the finance suite (Books, Invoice, Billing, Inventory, Expense, Payroll). Each specialist keeps judgement in SKILL.md, depth in references/, and carries a dated source note recording what was verified, against which documentation, and what could not be — so a stale fact is visible rather than inferred. Also ships BRD/PRD elicitation, WordPress and SEO migration, and finance and mail administration. Working conventions ship as a SessionStart hook so language and output format are right in the first reply rather than after a skill happens to trigger. Identity, agent-to-agent escalation, BAU and bug structure, and client-area layout are owned by the Global PM BRD and referenced, never restated. 0.2.1 applies the Opus 5.5 prompt audit: the product catalogue routes only to skills that exist and names the products not yet covered, the Kinsta skill uses MyKinsta, the Kinsta API and WP-CLI in place of an unpublished CLI, SEO guidance uses INP and GA4 key events, and the cfo and mail-admin bodies are tightened with their facts kept. 18 skills + 1 agent + SessionStart hook + a six-check validation harness.
